title: Sector Nine Rising
author: Lena Eastwick
blurb: Noor Nakamura, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
